The beginning of the fragrance is a little fruity with the raspberry combined with the saffron, which gives the impression of being a bit sweet and spicy. Gradually, it goes to the smoky and floral heart that feels deep and smooth. The base is all leather and suede, and it is warm, powerful, and long-lasting. This perfume is confident, mature, and luxurious, and it is ideal for bold fragrance lovers.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and sweet unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy deep gourmand scents. The opening is slightly sweet with a creamy feeling coming from the soft, nutty almond note. Then, the floral notes of the Tunisian orange blossom and Turkish rose come together with the warm cinnamon in a smooth and cozy heart of the fragrance. The dry down is where the magic stays, with tonka bean, vanilla and amberwood creating a long lasting, addictive scent trail.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum is a creamy, sweet, and woody scent made for men who like a bold and tempting fragrance. It opens with fresh pineapple mixed with ginger and a soft hint of iris, giving it a bright yet elegant start. Then the creamy coconut blends with deep wood notes, making the scent warm and slightly tropical. The base is smooth and sensual with tonka bean, sandalwood, amber, and ambergris. It feels sweet, masculine, addictive, and lasts well on skin, perfect for nights out and cooler days.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum is a bold, warm and mysterious women's perfume for those who love a strong presence. It starts off with a very intense jasmine scent that feels very creamy and floral upon the first spray. As it develops, delicate woody notes begin to come out and provide the scent with a deep and soothing quality. The dry down is smooth, very amber-like and lasts a long time, which makes Alien a signature scent for a lot of women.

products.title: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum is a creamy, bold and classy scent for both men and women. It mixes fresh citrus and spicy notes with a warm woody base that makes it perfect for all-day wear. The perfume presents a citrus explosion of orange and cardamom, then the sweet patchouli comes along with the hot pepper. The base notes give a thick combination of amber, cedar, vetiver and oakmoss which makes it really charming and powerful.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum is the definition of class and sophistication in a bottle. Inspired by the iconic YSL tuxedo suit, this fragrance is for anyone who wants to feel confident, elegant, and effortlessly stylish. It perfectly blends the boldness of spicy patchouli with the warmth of smooth vanilla, creating a scent that is both powerful and comforting.

Tuxedo smells like a luxurious night out. It has a modern yet timeless charm that makes you feel polished and ready for any special occasion. It’s the perfect fragrance for those who love rich, attractive scents that draw compliments and leave a lasting memory. One spray of YSL Tuxedo wraps you in an aura of pure elegance.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum for Women is a deep, warm, and elegant perfume which was made for the ladies who are self-assured. To begin with, there is a fragrant mixture of vanilla and amber which is strong, sweet and daring. The mid of the perfume consists of the gentle scent of jasmine that gives a delicate touch of flowers. The end notes are the warm and comforting ones which make the scent last for a long time and suit night, parties and special occasions.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum is an elegant men's scent that is dark, smooth, and modern. The fragrance starts off with a refreshing note of bergamot that is clean and sharp, but it later mixes with gentle angelica and deep patchouli. In the end, amber, musk, and coumarin create a dark, slightly sweet, and warm scent. This fragrance is self-assured, relaxed, and fashionable, which is why it is ideal for men who prefer classy and strong scents.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Moi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Moi Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and warm fragrance made for women who enjoy creamy perfumes. It opens with juicy peach and gentle jasmine that feel fresh yet slightly sweet. After some time, the caramel and amber start to come out, giving a rich and cosy vibe. The sandalwood and patchouli in the base make it smooth and long-lasting. It feels feminine, elegant and very comforting.

products.title: Ajmal  Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep oriental scent made for both men and women. It starts with the spiciness of black pepper, pink pepper and saffron, which are all together giving a powerful and fresh beginning. The middle note combines smoky cade oil with labdanum, balsam and rhubarb for a dark, warm and rich feeling. Finally, the base of smooth leather, cedar, guaiac wood, patchouli, moss and musk creates a fragrant, lasting and classy perfume.

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents. It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is a bold, classy, and warm fragrance that speaks of timeless elegance. Inspired by the royal city of Jaipur, this perfume blends zesty citrus, rich spices, and smooth vanilla for a scent that feels both powerful and comforting.

From the very first spray, fresh lemon and lemon verbena awaken your senses with a burst of energy. Soon, the heart reveals warm cinnamon and nutmeg, wrapping you in a spicy embrace. As it settles, creamy vanilla and woody notes create a deep, smooth finish that stays with you for hours.

Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is perfect for men who love confident, long-lasting fragrances that leave a mark wherever they go. Whether you are at a wedding, a formal dinner, or an evening out, this scent makes sure you’re remembered.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Green Irish Tweed EDT for men was launched in 1985 in France by Creed Boutique—a renowned fragrance house in high society. It is a fine blend of fresh green aromas that adds a timeless, sophisticated, and charismatic gentleman vibe to the masculine energy. It gives a clean and polished depth with its aromatic fougère DNA and soft natural notes of iris, vervain, violet leaves, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum is a creamy, luscious and sophisticated scent for women that is utterly warm and enigmatic. The fragrance begins with a peppery the spicy touch of ginger, and cardamom that is bold and rich. Bit by bit, the gentle notes of coconut, gardenia, and orange blossom are revealed and they make the fragrance smooth and feminine. At the end, sandalwood, musk, and amber provide an elegant and enduring finish. This fragrance is characterized by sensuality, self-assurance, and suitability for special occasions.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold, deep oriental woody perfume for men who like a strong presence. It opens with spicy, fresh notes of pink pepper, clary sage and saffron. The middle brings smooth ambroxan and dry cedar wood, which gives it a clean woody feel. The base is warm and long lasting with white musk, patchouli, amber and guaiac wood.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and creamy scent for both men and women. Starting with a golden soft and sweet mix of caramel and saffron, the heart contains suede, leather and tonka bean which smooth out the scent and give it depth. The vanilla, amber and musk in the base provide a long-lasting warm and pleasant trail.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Eau de Parfum is a light, floral, female fragrance, which is refreshing, sweet and very emotional. It begins with a fat pear and black currant with airy spiciness, which bruises the skin and is alive. Later on, there are soft flowers such as roses and jasmine, which make it very feminine. The woody and vanilla foundation is warm and makes it soft, classy, and durable on everyday or special occasions.

products.title: Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense is a bold, addictive, and modern fragrance made for women who love making a statement without saying a word. It opens with the luscious sweetness of ripe strawberries and juicy blackberries, fresh yet indulgent. The heart blooms with creamy jasmine, adding a soft, feminine touch. As it settles, the warmth of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood wraps around you like a cosy, luxurious blanket.

The perfume feels playful yet elegant, perfect for those moments when you want to feel glamorous, confident, and unforgettable. Whether it’s a romantic date night, a party, or a festive gathering, Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense leaves a trail that turns heads.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum is an affordable, luxurious, and unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. It is an interesting take on modern citrusy and crispy fruity notes of lemon and apple with warmer and heavier leather, patchouli, amber, and musk with a bit of nature-based accords of lily of the valley and oakmoss.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant and very feminine perfume. It reveals a combination of fresh rose and a delicate fruity touch of peach at the very beginning. The middle notes consist primarily of pure white musky scent, which is layered with the warmth of amber. The base consists of patchouli and sandalwood, which provide a smooth, woody finish.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz is a modern, fresh, and exquisite fragrance designed for everyone. It perfectly captures the feeling of a cool, gentle breeze on a warm day. Aariz is a scent that feels both sophisticated and comforting, blending bright, happy notes with a soft, clean heart.

Aariz smells like confidence and charm in a bottle. It has a beautiful freshness that makes it easy to wear, while its rich base gives it a character that is hard to forget. It’s the perfect choice for those who want a signature scent that is unique, versatile, and consistently receives compliments. One spray of Aariz makes you feel polished, modern, and ready for anything.

products.title: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum is a deep, bold, and intense unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent feels dark, spicy and smoky right from the first spray. It starts with a strong touch of incense combined with fresh citrus and warm spices that creates a strong first impression. As it dries, Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum grows more multifaceted and full bodied, the pleasant earth patchouli smell, tender flower and spice aromas fading in. It is heavy and long lasting with the smell of frankincense, oud, amber, vanilla and resin that are warm and mysterious and very luxurious.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum is a fresh, woody aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean yet bold fragrances. It opens with a lively mix of bergamot, apple, mint and elemi, offering a fresh, slightly sweet start. The middle notes of patchouli, jasmine, rose and sandalwood add a soft, woody, floral touch. In the dry down, cedar, oakmoss, amber and musk blend smoothly to create a warm, masculine base that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Mancera  Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum is a very strong, bold and dark fragrance made for people who love heavy scents. This was launched in 2023 as a more powerful and creamier version of the original Red Tobacco. It opens spicy and smoky, then slowly turns warm, sweet and woody. The high oil concentration makes it long lasting and very intense, so even small sprays are enough.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy men’s perfume who like bold and fresh smell. It opens with a bright citrus touch of bergamot and lemon with soft elemi. The middle notes create a woody and floral landscape with lily of the valley and jasmine, which is creamy and clean at the same time. The base is warm and long lasting with musk, patchouli and amber that stays on the skin.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco is a men-oriented Oriental Spicy fragrance. It was launched in 2024. This aroma begins with pink pepper, black pepper, cardamom, elemi and sage which creates an impression of freshness and spiciness. Tobacco in the heart is combined with chestnut, cinnamon leaf and a touch of soft chili, which adds flavor and a warmness. It is smooth, sweet and long-lasting on the body, with the help of the base of bourbon vanilla, amber, guaiac wood and benzoin.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum French Avenue is a fresh, fruitful and a bit warm perfume that is produced to suit both men and women. It opens with fat juicy black currant and blackberry with a fresh tint of bergamot and rosemary which feels good and cheerful. The vodka and raspberry are used in the middle with a sweet and smooth finish with a gentle floral touch. The fragrance is long lasting as the base is comfortable and full of musk, sandalwood, and amber.

products.title: Ajmal Avid Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: This perfume has a highly intense fragrance that attracts the young, suave male audience. The fragrance pools a wide range of fresh and heartening notes. The top notes carry fresh and fruity tones, merging into a woody aquatic heart that exudes an enlivening effect on the wearer. The top and heart culminate into a fascinating base, full of warm amber and patchouli to make the creation cast its charm.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Grand Soir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum is a creamy, warm and elegant unisex perfume launched in 2016 by the luxury French perfume house Maison Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a smooth mix of Spanish labdanum and a light touch of orange, which feels warm and slightly sweet. The heart brings lavender and Siam benzoin, which add a calm, resin like depth. The base is deep and comforting with amber, vanilla, tonka bean, musk and cedar, giving the perfume its signature long lasting warmth.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum is a rich and warm scent made for men who like deep and classy fragrances. It is a new release from the famous Al Haramain house in 2024. The perfume opens with spicy saffron, fresh bergamot and soft elemi. The heart carries strong agarwood with elegant Bulgarian rose and gentle lily of the valley. The base settles into sweet tonka bean, warm amber, clean white musk and earthy oakmoss.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex perfume made for those who love creamy and deep scents. It starts with a warm mix of saffron, lavender and fresh Italian mandarin that brings brightness and spice together. The heart opens with amberwood, cedar and geranium giving it a woody and slightly floral feel. The base of akigalawood, incense and labdanum adds smoky warmth that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smoky leather men’s perfume made for those who like strong scents. It was launched in 2023 and opens with incense, gaiac wood and saffron, which feels warm and mysterious. The middle brings leather with a soft, sweet touch from violet and sugar cane. The base is deep and smoky with patchouli, sandalwood, woods and black musk that stays long on skin. Overall, French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum feels powerful, mature and very confident.

products.title: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum is an oriental fragrance available for women and men. It was released in 2016 and developed by perfumer Aurélien Guichard. This fragrance begins with the notes of frankincense, raspberry, saffron and pear that are a bombard of smoky and sweet sweetness. Damask rose, musk and orange blossom, agarwood (oud) and leather with patchouli and ambergris are reported to be the damask rose, the base, and the other, respectively. It is courageous, intense and highly opulent to the skin.

products.title: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum is an elegant and bold fragrance created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion in 2010. It’s a timeless perfume that captures grace, mystery, and confidence in every spray. The fragrance opens with rich and spicy top notes of rose, clove, cinnamon, black currant, and red berries. The heart unfolds with Turkish rose, patchouli, incense, sandalwood, and ylang-ylang, blending beautifully into a deep and sensual base of musk, amber, benzoin, cedar, ambergris, vanilla, and incense.

products.title: Versace Eros Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Parfum is an Oriental Fougere perfume product by Versace, a male perfume. In 2021, Versace Eros Parfume was released. The perfume opens with fresh, brisk aromas of mint and lemon, a subtle spicy note of black pepper, elemi, and litsea cubeba. The heart offers a pleasant and fragrant combination of green apple, geranium, lavender, sage and pomarose. Tonka bean, amber, vanilla, patchouli and benzoin are used in the base to provide a warm and sweet, long-lasting finish that is rich and masculine.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette is a soft, classy women’s perfume. It is known for its clean musky feel with light flowers and warm woods. This fragrance feels elegant but simple, not loud at all. It has a fresh and floral opening, gradually becoming creamy and warm on the skin. It is a perfume that feels very close, smooth and comforting, so that it is suitable for everyday use and special moments as well.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and airy unisex fragrance made for daily wear. It was launched in 2022 and opens with bright citrus and green notes that feel light and refreshing from the first spray. As it settles, soft, spicy and minty tones come forward, giving a calm and cooling feel. The base is smooth and slightly aquatic with ambergris and soft floral notes, making the scent feel modern, new and easy to wear.

products.title: Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean perfume that is bright and classy on the skin of men. It starts off with a citrusy burst of lemon, bergamot and orange that is very fresh and invigorating. Gradually, it passes into a creamy centre of neroli, green tea and light spices, which are soothing and graceful. Vetiver, musk and soft woods form the base to providea clean woody finish which remains fresh on skin. This perfume is relaxed, luxurious and easy to wear.

products.title: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. Launched in 2017, it is a fresh yet deep scent that combines citrus and woody tones beautifully. The perfume opens with a shot of grapefruit, lemon, and mandarin orange. The middle brings calming lavender, geranium, vetiver, and patchouli, while the base settles into amber, sandalwood, cedar, and precious woods. It is a bold, energetic fragrance that gives a classy vibe for all-day wear.

products.title: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance that is fresh and clean, light, cool, and classy at the same time. Citrus freshness that is very sharp and refreshing is the first thing that you notice when you spray it. After some time, a little bit of soft spicy and herbal notes get revealed and create a very nice balancing act. In the end, a gentle touch of woody and musky notes is almost imperceptibly close to the skin but still exudes a calm and masculine aura. This fragrance is an excellent choice for everyday use, for the office, and in hot climates.

products.title: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum is a soft yet bold feminine scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It is a pretty oriental floral perfume that opens with fresh, spicy notes of blood orange, pink pepper and lemon zest, giving a bright, lively feel. The heart opens to romantic damask rose, light freesia and relaxing tea leaf, and the smell is graceful and soft. The base settles into white musk, patchouli and amberwood, providing a warm and slightly sweet end that remains near the skin and is comforting.

products.title: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Intense Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and deep men’s fragrance at the same time. The fragrance opens with a loud iris note that is clean, powdery, and elegant at the same time. Intense warmth from amber and patchouli slowly comes in and gives the fragrance a rich and slightly dark vibe. The base of leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood makes it creamy, woody, and long-lasting. This fragrance exudes maturity, confidence, and is perfect for men who appreciate strong yet clean scents.

products.title: Dunhill  Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and masculine perfume for men. Launched in 2021, it opens with zesty and fresh top notes of lime, bergamot and ambroxan, followed by spicy and aquatic notes of sea salt, cardamom, neroli and coriander. The base notes of driftwood, ambergris, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm and woody finish.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels rich, warm and slightly spicy with a deep Arabic touch. It opens with a fresh spicy mix of pink pepper, bright Sicilian bergamot and sweet davana that feels uplifting and classy. The heart is warm and resinous with white amber, agarwood and herbal rosemary, giving a calm but powerful feel. The base is deep and long lasting with leather, earthy Haitian vetiver, and soft musk that stays on skin for hours and feels luxurious.

products.title: Al Wataniah Lazuli Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Lazuli Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet warm oriental fragrance made for both men and women. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel clean, juicy and uplifting. As the scent settles, soft white florals come forward, adding a smooth and elegant touch. The base is warm amber, which gives the perfume a slightly sweet and long lasting finish.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Calvin klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette is a masculine fragrance which was launched in 2011 this scent opens with a sharp burst of lavender, juicy clementine and refreshing cucumber the middle reveals a spicy combination of cardamom, pepper, basil and osmanthus creating an energetic kick. Finally this fragrance dries down into an addictive base of tobacco, amber, patchouli, woodsy notes and musk
This composition offers a modern twist with its oriental spicy accords making it an ideal choice for men who enjoy a confident and powerful scent.

products.title: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody men's perfume, which is clean, smooth, and classy. It begins with the ripe apple and sunny bergamot touch that is vigorous and crisp. Gradually, the heart is made more of cedarwood and soft violet, so that it feels rather peaceful and slightly dusty. On its foundation, oakmoss, musk, and amber provide a very cosy and lasting effect. It is stinking of modernity, confident, and easy to wear.

products.title: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Eclat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Éclat Eau de Parfum is a bright and fruity floral fragrance for women that feels sweet, fresh, and warm. The opening is juicy and lively with mango, Sicilian lemon, wild berries, and a soft touch of pink pepper. Slowly, the heart turns creamy and slightly spicy with ginger and jasmine, blended with smooth tonka bean and vanilla. In the dry down, white musk, amber, and vetiver give a clean, soft, and long-lasting finish. It feels sunny, feminine, and perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver Eau de Parfum is a smooth, classy unisex scent from the famous Arabic brand Lattafa. It opens with a bright and zesty start of lemon and bergamot, mixing beautifully with a juicy pineapple and a spicy touch of black pepper in the middle. As it settles, warm base notes of vanilla, amberwood, cedar and patchouli take over, giving it a rich, deep and cozy finish.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum is one of those perfumes that are warm, daring, and classic all at once, and the oriental richness is definitely the main reason for its popularity among perfume lovers. It starts with citrus notes, illuminating bergamot and lemon, then goes into a deep floral-earthy heart consisting of iris, jasmine, rose, vetiver, and patchouli, finally ending in a soft base of vanilla, incense, leather, sandalwood, and musk. It is perceived as classic, smooth, slightly smoky, and elegant with a very effortless touch.

products.title: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum is a unisex perfume, which is warm, sweet, and spicy in scent. French Avenue released this perfume in 2024, and it is created to be liked by those who appreciate both strong and smooth odours. It begins with a fat cherry that is intertwined with a light ginger touch, followed by the soft jasmine. The foundation is comfortable and warm, which makes it ideal to wear it daily and for evening use.

products.title: Burberry Mr Burberry Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Mr Burberry Eau de Parfum is a deep, warm and classy men's perfume that is strong and contemporary. It begins with new tones of fresh cardamom, mint, and grapefruit, which provide a spic,y clean beginning. Gradually, lavender and nutmeg create a soothing and mellowing touch. The scent is rich and long-term because of the foundation of patchouli, amber, and woods. This perfume is manly, assertive and suitable for men who enjoy a bold yet classy smell.

products.title: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette is a sweet and fresh fragrance that women who appreciate simple yet luxurious perfumes can use. The fragrance begins with a combination of green almond and lime, complemented by pear, making it light and cheerful. The smell evolves into a sweet mixture of sugar and almond that give a cozy and relaxing effect. The amber and vanilla base of the perfume forms a softness that is close to the body. This aroma is very classy and soothing, and can be utilised easily by people every day.

products.title: Billie Eilish No. 1
products.body_html: Billie Eilish No. 1 Eau de Parfum is the first fragrance by Billie Eilish. It is warm, sweet and slightly spicy, wrapped around soft vanilla and cacao. The perfume opens with sugar, red berries and mandarin orange that feel bright and sweet. The heart brings in a smooth combination of vanilla, cacao, rose, and a hint of spice. The base is cosy with amber, tonka bean, musk, and woody notes that stay close to the skin. It feels sensual, sweet, and comforting, just like Billie wanted it to be.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette is an up-to-date, fresh male perfume which is clean, vibrant and slightly woody. The perfume begins with a refreshing burst of bright bergamot, ginger and aldehydes that provide a fresh and refreshing kick to the perfume. Then, a few minutes later, lavender, sage and geranium are added and provide a soft aromatic touch. During the dry down, ambergris, vanilla, cedar and olibanum form a soft and somehow warm foundation that remains pleasant on the skin.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette is a powerful and timeless scent for men that projects an image of boldness, cleanliness, and strength. It starts with a crisp and fresh odor that is very cheerful and somewhat spicy, then gradually changes to warmth and depth. The combination of herbs, flowers, and animalic notes gives it a very masculine and assured character. This fragrance is a classic, heavy, and best suited for the men who appreciate strong perfumes.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Man Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Swiss Arabian. It opens with a clean mix of citrus and lavender that feels fresh and energetic from the first spray. As it settles, you can feel the spiciness and the marine notes, which contribute to the fragrance a little depth and a pleasant oceanic feel. The warm, sweet and woody base is formed by the blending of amber, patchouli, and creamy praline notes.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a sweet, soft and elegant women's fragrance. It opens with juicy fruity notes of peach, orange and bergamot mixed with fresh green accords that feel bright and happy. The heart comes with creamy white florals like jasmine, tuberose and orchid blended with heliotrope and lily-of-the-valley, giving a powdery, feminine touch. The dry down is warm and cozy with caramel, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and patchouli creating a sweet yet classy scent trail that feels smooth and comforting.

products.title: Rabanne Mesh Metal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Mesh Metal Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent. Launched in 2024, it offers a fresh citrus opening, soft floral notes and warm base tones. The fragrance opens with bright notes of lime, bigarade and petitgrain, giving it a crisp, slightly bitter citrus feel. In the middle sits an orange blossom, adding a light floral sweetness. The drydown settles into ambergris, giving a soft, warm, skin like scent that feels clean, airy and slightly musky.

products.title: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette is a clean, fresh, and classic men’s perfume with a bright citrus start, warm spices, and earthy woody notes that stay smooth on the skin. It opens with bergamot, lemon, nutmeg, neroli, coriander, tobacco, and mandarin orange, followed by middle notes of vetiver, pepper, carnation, sage, sandalwood, and orris root. The scent dries down to vetiver, oakmoss, leather, tonka bean, amber, civet, and myrrh, giving a natural and timeless feel.

products.title: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum is a deep, creamy and bold unisex fragrance. Launched in 2025, this perfume opens with a smoky, spicy touch of incense and cardamom mixed with fresh basil and bergamot. As it settles, the middle brings warm tobacco, soft lavender and a slightly bitter note of fenugreek that gives it a unique twist. The base is heavy, warm and long lasting with Peru balsam, oud, amber and tonka bean, making the scent feel smooth, dark and comforting.

products.title: Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and slightly sweet men’s perfume that feels very easy to wear. It has a cool and energizing start that is opened up with juicy fruity notes and fresh mint. The heart is spicy and watery with the sounds that are modern and youthful. The base is warm and soft with woody and amber shades which remain intimate to the skin.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold and cozy fragrance made for both men and women. It starts with a creamy blend of incense and coffee, which has a hint of rose that provides a nice beginning. The cedar and cashmere wood make the heart stiff and chilly, which gives the scent a rich texture. As it dries down, Spicy Amber becomes creamy and slightly sweet with vanilla, mixed with earthy vetiver and clean musk.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum is an intense, sensual, and elegant fragrance that captures the essence of a rainy evening in London. Inspired by the iconic Burberry trench coat and the beauty of blooming flowers after the rain, this perfume blends floral richness with warm, deep notes for a luxurious experience.

The fragrance opens with a burst of jasmine, creating a bright yet smooth introduction. The heart reveals the sweetness of peach and the romantic elegance of rose, while the base wraps you in warm amber and earthy patchouli.

Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum feels like slipping into a classic trench coat on a rainy night, walking through a garden filled with blossoms, and enjoying the comforting embrace of warm, golden lights. It is perfect for women who want to feel confident, feminine, and unforgettable.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette is a lovely, elegant, and somewhat enigmatic fragrance for women that is reminiscent of creamy flowers. It begins with a spicy mix of pepper, cardamom, and ginger, which is fresh yet warm at the same time. It gradually transitions to a delicate floral heart where gardenia and orange blossom are rich and ladies-like. The combination of sandalwood, musk, and amber at the base provides a warm and clean finish, which is very close to the skin and feels very classy.

products.title: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme
products.body_html: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme Parfum Cologne is a fresh, clean and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Roja Parfums. The fragrance shines with its top note of vibrant citruses that impart an energetic and contemporary feel. The middle note reveals a combination of green, fruity and lightly spicy scents that embody smoothness and confidence. The warm, velvety and slightly buttery base of the concoction contributes a richness and longevity, thus making it hard to miss and very alluring. It smells elegant, masculine and very uplifting, perfect for men who like fresh but premium perfumes.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette is a fresh, unisex scent that feels clean, airy and a bit salty, like a morning by the sea. It opens with cool sea notes, aldehydes, coriander and a tiny hint of red pepper that gives a soft kick. The middle brings iris, juniper, rose and a fresh green vibe from amyl salicylate. The base settles into seaweed, ambergris, cedar and amberwood, which gives it a smooth, warm dry down, just like skin after a swim in the ocean.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, richer version of the original BR540. This perfume brings a warm, sweet and slightly spicy feeling with saffron, bitter almond, jasmine, cedar and strong ambergris tones. It feels smooth, bright and luxurious, with a soft woody and musky base that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Lattafa Mazaaji Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mazaaji, by Lattafa Perfumes, is a floral female fragrance product. It starts with Orange blossoms and mandarin orange notes placed on top, making it fresh and slightly sweet at the beginning. Bulgarian rose, Turkish rose and jasmine are used as the middle notes and provide the heart of the floral richness and the romanticism. Patchouli, vanilla, amber and sandalwood are the base notes; they add warmth, softness and protracted sweetness to the odour.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense is a men's fragrance of Woody. L’eau d’Issey Pour Homme Intense was introduced in 2007. Behind this perfume, there is Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. It introduces fresh tones of Yuzu, Bergamot, Sweet Orange and Mandarin Orange, and it is succeeded by Nutmeg, Lotus, Cardamom, Cinnamon and Saffron. The foundation is hot and smoky, containing Incense, Papyrus, Ambergris, and Amber.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and warm fragrance made for women who love a little fruity and creamy touch. It opens with juicy pink grapefruit, red apple and peach that feel fresh and playful. Slowly, rose petals, magnolia, and orange blossom come in and give a pretty floral heart. In the dry down, musk, vanilla and amber make it smooth, cosy and long-lasting. It feels feminine, gentle and very easy to wear.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance. Launched in 2023, it carries a warm oriental woody scent profile that blends fruity herbal freshness with deep woody richness. The opening starts with davana, bergamot and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet spicy feel. The heart unfolds into creamy agarwood, oud, amber and rosemary that create a warm aromatic body. The base settles into leather, vetiver and musk, which adds depth, softness and a long lasting trail. The blend feels smooth, bold and balanced with a classy Middle Eastern touch.

products.title: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum, a fresh and powerful fragrance for men, is a perfect choice for those who want to stay bright, clean, and lively. The fragrance starts with a strong and very fresh burst of citrus notes that are really energizing. Gradually, it goes to a spicy and slightly sweet heart that provides depth and balance. The base is woody and musky, resulting in a smooth and long-lasting finish. This scent is modern, confident, and bold, absolutely perfect for men who prefer fresh but strong perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum for men is a lavish and classy scent with an excellent combination of warm and woody tones. The fragrance starts off with fresh and lively bergamot, which is combined with the soft feel of rum and vanilla in the middle, then ends with a strong base of patchouli. This perfume was made by Delphine Jelk in 2024 and is very much appreciated for its elegant smell and stamina, hence, it is perfect for nighttime or special events.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette is a male perfume that was introduced in 1996. It is produced using fresh citrus tones, sea tones and gentle woody tones that are very clean and natural. The introductory is bright, fresh and very gradually becomes liquid and smooth. During the dry down, it is hot and dry. This perfume is light, clean and comfortable to use; it suits everyday and hot seasons.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the popular house of Armaf it starts with spicy pink pepper, citrus yuzu and fresh grapefruit that give an energetic start and in the middle violet leaf and sea notes add a soft, clean and slightly green touch. The end notes are warm and woody with amber, amberwood and guaiac wood making it a balanced everyday perfume. It feels refreshing, youthful and modern perfect for men who like a combination of freshness with warmth.

products.title: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette is a fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2007, it mixes fruity, aromatic, and woody notes into a smooth and lively scent. The perfume opens with crisp green apple and bitter orange, giving a fresh and bright start. Its heart is warm with tea and subtle spices, while the base brings a masculine touch of musk, tonka bean, vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, and amber. Chrome Legend is a perfect mix of freshness and depth for everyday wear.

products.title: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, woody scent for men who like warm, spicy, smooth perfumes. It opens with spicy cardamom and sharp Sichuan pepper, which gives a fresh heat at the start. The heart features creamy woods like sandalwood, oud and vetiver, which give the scent depth and class. In drydown, creamy tonka bean, amber and vanilla mix together and create a soft, sweet, warm trail.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and woody scent made for men who like strong but clean fragrance. It opens with sweet notes of vanilla, saffron and jasmine that give a soft and rich start. In the heart, you get lavender, amberwood, green leaves and cedar that make it calm, smooth, and classy. The dry down is deep and earthy with violet, fir resin and cedar that stay warm on skin for hours.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance that mixes freshness with deep woody warmth. It opens with a burst of fruity notes, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple that give a clean and bright start. The nature of the scent turns richer with pepper, birch, patchouli, jasmine, lavender and rose, adding spice and class. In the end, musk, amber and vanilla create a smooth and comforting base that lasts long.

products.title: Chopard Amber Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Amber Malaki Eau De Parfum is an oriental unisex scent that feels warm, deep, and elegant. Launched in 2015, it is part of Chopard’s luxurious Malaki collection, inspired by the beauty of Middle Eastern perfumery. It opens with soft orange blossom and papyrus, leading to incense and labdanum at the heart, and finishes beautifully with warm amber and sweet vanilla at the base. This perfume gives a golden glow and feels like a cosy, classy evening wrapped in scent.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold unisex perfume. This scent gives a clean, airy and modern feel with a mix of citrus, herbs and woody notes. It opens with bright bergamot, calming lavender and rosemary. The heart brings sea notes with geranium and sage, giving a cool ocean touch. The base is warm and earthy with moss, amber, vetiver and cedar.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and elegant unisex perfume from Al Haramain Perfumes. This scent brings a clean citrus start with spicy and woody heart and a deep, warm base. The opening gives fresh grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper. The middle note is dominated by ginger vetiver jasmine that contributes soft spice and a floral accent. The base is composed of olibanum, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli, which make it creamy, smooth and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition Eau de Parfum is a warm, creamy and bold unisex perfume. This fragrance is made for people who love deep, sweet and spicy tobacco style scents. It opens with strong notes of tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, which feel spicy and cozy at the same time. The heart is creamy and sweet with vanilla, cloves, star anise, tonka bean, cacao and incense, giving it a smooth, addictive feel. The base settles into tobacco dried fruits and woody notes that feel warm, luxurious and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, oriental floral scent for both men and women. It opens with a romantic Damask rose and a creamy praline note that gives a sweet feel from the start. The middle features sugar, white musk and jasmine sambac, making the scent smooth, light, floral and cozy. Drydown has amber xtreme, vanilla and patchouli, giving a warm, long lasting base with a slightly sweet, woody touch.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Mancera  Amore Caffe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Amore Caffè Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex perfume made for coffee lovers. This scent opens with a creamy coffee note mixed with soft amaretto, giving a creamy, slightly nutty feel. The middle art feels gourmand and smooth with ice cream and speculoos, which makes it sweet and comforting. The base is deep and addictive with brown sugar, vanilla and ambergris that stays close to the skin and feels very cozy.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum is a clean, fresh and sharp fragrance for men & women that feels bright and confident. It opens with cold and crisp notes like juniper berries, nutmeg, bergamot and a small touch of pineapple that makes the start feel energetic. The heart brings coriander for a dry spicy tone, while the base settles into soft musk, woody notes, cedar, amber and a hint of vanilla.

products.title: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette is a fresh scent. It feels like you’re standing right by the ocean. But there's a nice woody accent mixed in too. It came out in 2011. It has a bright, zesty opening. You get a big rush of lemon, bergamot, green leaves, tangerine, and a small hint of pink pepper. It feels like a sunny morning. The middle section is cool and deep. This gives it a manly feel. That comes from melon, patchouli, vetiver, wood smells, sage, and galbanum. In the end, it gets warm. You get a lingering fresh scent from musk, oakmoss, and amber. This fragrance is for men who like clean, fresh, and maybe slightly spicy smells.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum is a fresh and energetic citrus perfume made for men who like clean and bright scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy mandarin, orange and bergamot that feel fresh and uplifting from the first spray. The heart has a spicy ginger note that adds a sharp and warm touch. The base settles into smooth ambergris, giving the scent a soft, masculine finish that stays pleasant and classy.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nitro Paris Platinum Eau de Parfum is a contemporary woody fragrance perfume targeting men who prefer serious and sweet perfumes. It begins with a fresh and juicy combination of spices and fruits that is vibrant and vigorous. Gradually, it becomes warm and smooth vanilla, sugar, and soft woods. The foundation is deep, creamy, and long-lasting with a great and assertive feel. The perfume seems trendy, very expensive and can be worn daily or on nights.

products.title: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich and very confident unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. It was revealed in 2017 and it is famous for the full bodied leather combined with the warm and creamy notes. It starts with the fresh and sweet scent of lavender and clary sage, which gives a pure but also an edgy beginning. The middle is very strong and very much like leather, burnt almond, vanilla and orris, holding the sweetness but still being powerful. The base remains long with leather, tonka bean, cashmeran, white woods and amber, creating a warm, sexy and lasting trail.
